title: ScopeProfile
_comment: run-10 D3: this schema is exactly what the 5.x pipeline consumes, nothing more.
`domains` is the only field that changes what gets reviewed (driver coverage
widening); `tools` feeds the non-gating scanner disclosure; the rest is identity
facet_scope properties were REMOVED: nothing read them. lenses/depth existed for
dispatch.build_plan's panel_review/lens_sweep entries, which the driver has not
dispatched since 5.0, and applicable_global_floor deliberately ignores scout
surfaces/has_tests (#1193). Requiring them only compelled every scout to
additionalProperties stays permissive so an older profile still validates.
